title: How to stop Claude from saying load-bearing
summary: A developer blog post explaining techniques to customize Claude (Anthropic's AI assistant) to avoid using repetitive phrases like 'load-bearing' that have become meme-worthy in the AI community, through prompt engineering and API configuration.
problem_solved: Prevents AI assistants from using annoying, repetitive filler phrases that degrade conversation quality
why_valuable: Improves AI interaction quality by customizing behavior to match specific use cases and preferences
